recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-5259 as already applied; any future broader wording changes to OperationOutcome or DetectedIssue boundaries should be handled under a new tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CDS ballot comment for the former Contraindication resource asking to clarify an OperationOutcome/Contraindication boundaries sentence that used ambiguous first/latter wording. The Jira application comment records that the proposed wording had the roles the wrong way around, so the applied intent was explicit names without reversing the resource roles.
initial_application: Git commit cd642032db8c6662c59358e5770f771d3ac5890f, imported from svn revision 4404, applied FHIR-5259 by replacing first/latter wording in source/contraindication/contraindication-introduction.xml with explicit OperationOutcome and Contraindication names. Commit f0f6a05d8a7599d9a4be1f64d962e8f24ee884c3 later copied the same relationship into the OperationOutcome introduction.
additional_context: FHIR-8043 renamed Contraindication to DetectedIssue, and commit 1408563d743f15eff785f59063b34b538b4d4651 preserved the corrected sentence during that rename. source/fhir.ini lists detectedissue as an active current resource. Searches found no current source retaining the ambiguous first/latter text or reversed Contraindication/OperationOutcome roles, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope source already reflects the FHIR-5259 correction after the DetectedIssue rename.
